candidates.title: Akash Anand back in BSP fold after apology to Mayawati, gets key post again
candidates.excerpt: BSP national president Mayawati has reinstated her nephew Akash Anand as the national coordinator of the party. His reappointment follows an apology to her regarding his previous actions and a willingness to serve again. Anand had previously faced removal from the BSP due to perceived loyalty conflicts involving family ties. Mayawati emphasized the importance of maintaining discipline within the party and her family's role in that regard.

candidates.title: ‘SC scheduled, then cancelled meet’: One Nation, One Election JPC chief amid controversy
candidates.excerpt: PP Chaudhary provided clarification about the cancelled meeting set between the parliamentary panel and Supreme Court judges. He stated that the Supreme Court had initially scheduled the meeting for October 6 and later cancelled it. Chaudhary emphasized that previous interactions between parliamentary committees and the judiciary are not without precedent. Former Union minister Kapil Sibal criticized the meeting's constitutionality, arguing it undermined the separation of powers.

candidates.title: UP Rajya Sabha elections: BJP releases list of 8 candidates; Ministers Hardeep Puri, BL Verma dropped
candidates.excerpt: The BJP has announced eight candidates for the Rajya Sabha elections in Uttar Pradesh, where polls will be held for 10 seats. Notably, several current members are not included. The Samajwadi Party also named two candidates. Nominations are due on October 6, and voting is on October 16.
